statement: Each MI400 GPU carries 432 GB of HBM4, a 50% increase over the MI350's 288 GB of HBM3e
why: Every new accelerator now eats noticeably more memory than the one it replaces, so memory becomes scarcer even if chip output stays flat.

impact.mechanism: Rising memory content per accelerator raises HBM bit demand faster than unit shipments grow, tightening an already constrained memory supply chain.

evidence.source: Market/trade press aggregation (AMD MI400 series product launch; official amd.com product page fetch timed out)
evidence.excerpt: a 50% increase over the MI350's 288 GB of HBM3e

confidence.basis: Secondary trade-press figures with an internal bandwidth discrepancy the document leaves unresolved.
